========================================================================
  6. SIGNAL EDGE & SUBTRACTION CANDIDATES (Stage 1)
========================================================================
Each scoring sub-score is meant to REWARD a setup. This ranks them by
rank-association with realized outcome and flags the ones that don't
earn their points: HARMFUL (negative) or INERT (near-zero). These are
subtraction CANDIDATES only — re-weighting is a separate guarded step.

-- Win quality (durable vs cash-grab) ----------------------------------
  durable wins: 16   cash-grab wins: 8 (round-trip to stop within 5 bars of target)
  median bars target->stop among round-trips: 5.00

Primary outcome: durable_win  (n=60, minority class=16, noise floor |r| < 0.15)

-- Subtraction shortlist -----------------------------------------------
  HARMFUL (down-weight / zero): score_touch_density, score_lps_tightness, score_traversal_quality
  INERT   (candidate to trim):  score_base_age, score_vol_contraction, score_setup_quality, score_atr_squeeze

-- !  TARGET DISAGREEMENT — do not act on the shortlist for these ------
  score_touch_density, score_lps_tightness, score_traversal_quality, score_box_tightness
  'durable_win' resolves on whichever barrier is hit FIRST
  (a stop 3% under support); P(MFE>=25%) asks only what the setup
  ever OFFERED, and needs no label so it keeps the rows the barrier
  gate drops. Where they split, the signal reaches further and holds
  it worse — or one target sees value the other cannot. Rule which
  one you are paid for BEFORE down-weighting anything above.
